rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for unequal or discriminatory treatment based on sex or gender.

example.english: The company must not practise sexism; promotions should be based on ability.
example.traditional: 公司唔可以有性別歧視，升職應該睇能力。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 m4 ho2 ji5 jau5 sing3 bit6 kei4 si6 sing1 zik1 jing1 goi1 tai2 nang4 lik6

rows.note: Use this for a prejudiced belief or assumption that one sex or gender is inherently superior or different.

example.english: Thinking women are naturally unsuitable for management is sexism.
example.traditional: 覺得女人天生唔適合做管理層，呢種就係性別偏見。
example.jyutping: gok3 dak1 neoi5 jan2 tin1 saang1 m4 sik1 hap6 zou6 gun2 lei5 cang4 ne1 zung2 zau6 hai6 sing3 bit6 pin1 gin3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the traditional belief that men should rank above women.

example.english: People used to think men should support the family while women stayed home—that was really sexism.
example.traditional: 以前啲人覺得男人應該養家，女人就留喺屋企，真係男尊女卑。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 naam4 jan2 jing1 goi1 joeng5 gaa1 neoi5 jan2 zau6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 zan1 hai6 naam4 zyun1 neoi5 bei1
